CHAPTER 14 · ITEM 12 / 12

Short run and long run

Scale economies規模經濟

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Identify economies of scale, constant returns to scale and diseconomies of scale from how long-run average total cost changes with output; explain specialization and coordination as possible reasons.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

規模經濟是長期 ATC 隨產量下降；不變規模報酬是 ATC 持平；規模不經濟是 ATC 上升，可能來自協調困難。這與固定投入下 MP 遞減不同。

Economies of scale mean LRATC falls as output grows, often through specialization. Constant returns to scale mean LRATC is unchanged; diseconomies mean it rises, possibly because coordination becomes harder. Distinguish this from diminishing MP with fixed inputs.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Doubling all inputs doubles output: unchanged cost per unit. If coordination makes costs rise faster than output, LRATC rises.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Output expands and LRATC falls. What is present? 產量增加、長期平均成本下降？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
